title: The coproduct of the sheafified free presheaves on representables with coefficients in a separator is a separator of the sheaf category
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a category with a Grothendieck topology $J$, and let $\mathcal A$ be a preadditive category with all coproducts (of the size of the Hom-sets of $\mathcal C$) for which sheafification $\mathrm{PSh}(\mathcal C;\mathcal A)\to\mathrm{Sh}(\mathcal C,J;\mathcal A)$ exists. Let $G$ be a separator of $\mathcal A$ (for $u\neq v:M\to N$ there is $h:G\to M$ with $uh\neq vh$). For $X\in\mathrm{Ob}(\mathcal C)$ let $G_X^\#$ be the sheaf associated to the presheaf $V\mapsto\bigoplus_{\varphi\in\mathrm{Mor}_{\mathcal C}(V,X)}G$; then $\mathrm{Hom}(G_X^\#,F)\cong\mathrm{Hom}_{\mathcal A}(G,F(X))$ naturally in the sheaf $F$, and whenever the coproduct $\coprod_{X\in\mathrm{Ob}(\mathcal C)}G_X^\#$ exists in $\mathrm{Sh}(\mathcal C,J;\mathcal A)$ it is a separator of $\mathrm{Sh}(\mathcal C,J;\mathcal A)$.
